```yaml
name: E2E Flows

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: env.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true'

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        cache: 'pnpm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install

    - name: Generate ngrok URL
      id: ngrok
      uses: ngrok/setup-ngrok-action@v2
      with:
        authtoken: ${{ secrets.NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
        domain: inbox-zero.ngrok.io

    - name: Export ngrok URL
      run: echo "::set-output name=ngrok_url::http://${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.public_url }}"

    - name: Configure environment variables
      run: |
        echo "NGROK_URL=${{ steps.ngrok.outputs.ngrok_url }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
```
